text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain feels satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider whether the investment still fits my plan.","Selling winners early can leave less invested if prices keep rising, so I should avoid letting the pleasure of locking in gains drive every decision.","I traded several times in the first three periods, then held in the next two; with prices unpredictable, I should make deliberate decisions rather than react to daily moves."]}
